semantics.clock: All state transitions sample inputs at posedge clk.
semantics.reset: Active-high asynchronous reset on posedge areset; while asserted reset dominates clock. Sets walking left, remembered direction left, and fall duration zero. No power-up state guaranteed without reset.
semantics.outputs: Moore outputs: walking left/right assert corresponding walking output only; falling asserts aaah only; digging asserts digging only; splattered asserts none.
semantics.walking: When ground=0 enter falling retaining direction. Otherwise dig=1 enters digging retaining direction. Otherwise bump in current direction reverses walking direction; both bumps therefore reverse direction.
semantics.digging: Remain digging regardless of dig and bumps while ground=1. On ground=0 enter falling retaining direction.
semantics.falling: Ignore bumps and dig. Remain falling while ground=0. At ground=1 resume remembered walking direction if fall duration <=20, else enter permanent splattered state.
semantics.duration: Entry edge into falling starts duration at 1 for its first falling clock interval. Every subsequent edge remaining airborne increments duration. Thus 20 consecutive falling output intervals survive landing; 21 splatter on landing. Never splatter while airborne.

numeric.fall_duration: Unsigned 5-bit count saturating at 21; represents exact duration through 20 and all durations exceeding 20 without wraparound.
numeric.other_arithmetic: No data arithmetic, rounding, or signed operations.

verification.method: Independent behavioral scoreboard using abstract activity, remembered direction, and integer duration; compare all outputs after each rising edge and asynchronous reset.
verification.directed: Both walking directions; each and simultaneous bumps; fall/dig/bump priority; persistent digging; bump/dig ignored during falls and landing; falls of 1,19,20,21,22,32,100 cycles; repeated falls; absorbing splatter; reset in walking, digging, falling and splattered states.
verification.random: Deterministic pseudorandom inputs with repeated resets and scoreboard checks.
verification.tools: Icarus v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; finite compile and simulation timeouts; no official tests, synthesis, or hardware.
